blocks.text: Murrayville Houses for Sale and Other Homes

parts.t: Murrayville sits on both sides of the Fraser Highway just east of the City of Langley, in the Township of Langley. The Township calls it its traditional civic core. Homes for sale are mostly detached houses, from older homes on larger lots to newer streets, plus townhomes and some condos.
Murrayville has its own community plan and part of it is a heritage conservation area, so check the rules for the exact lot before you plan changes.
A five-corner intersection at the centre of a heritage conservation area, one of only two in the Township. The Traveller's Hotel (1887) is a scheduled heritage property.
Langley Memorial Hospital at 22051 Fraser Highway has 24/7 emergency care. The Langley RCMP main detachment and Murrayville Library are also here.
W.C. Blair Recreation Centre is at 22200 Fraser Highway. McLeod Athletic Park (56 Avenue and 216 Street) and Murrayville Outdoor Activity Park (48A Avenue and 221 Street) are nearby.
The community plan calls for the banks of the Nicomekl River and Murray Creek to be preserved.
The South of Murrayville aquifer (Aquifer 51) is one of three where most of the Township's flowing artesian wells are found.

Is Langley Memorial Hospital in Murrayville?
